brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent full-depth bins (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full) in joined pieces (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full with jointBolt:0#0,0#0) provide upright storage for kitchen utensils.
Build contains exactly 2 bin parts: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full at 0,0,0 and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full at 1,0,0.

Both bins are solid non-drained variant hex-bin-full, not hex-bin-full-drain/drain-pill etc. Sides and bottom are continuous so they contain water for washing utensils; meshClash is clear. No drain holes selected.

Geometry is dishwasher-compatible (open plastic trays with no electronics/wood, solid hex-bin-full bins can be removed and placed on rack). However configurator does not certify material/food-grade or temperature rating; actual dishwasher safety depends on filament choice (e.g., PETG/ASA vs PLA) which is outside mesh check. No material tag in catalog to guarantee.

finish.summary: Built a 2-cell utensil holder with two solid full-depth bins (hex-bin-full) locked together with a joint bolt. Solid bins satisfy waterproof containment by avoiding drained variants; meshClash clear and LOOSE_BODY resolved. Dishwasher safety is partially met geometrically but cannot be fully certified from configurator material data alone.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
